<a id="liwa"></a>
## `liwa`

调用方式: `liwa --help`

```text
Usage: liwa [--profile] <name> [options] [app-args...]
       liwa plugin --profile <name> <pnpm-args...>

liwa: boot a Liwa profile — an ordered stack of plugin-bundle patch layers under
your own overrides.

Arguments:
  args                           arguments for the booted profile's app (see:
                                 liwa --profile <name> --help)

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  --profile <name>               the profile under $LIWA_HOME/profiles to boot
  --from-default-profile <name>  replace a custom profile with a fresh copy of a
                                 shipped profile template
  --patch <path>                 extra patch-list overlay applied after the
                                 profile layer (repeatable)
  --dump-config                  print the composed profile tree and exit
  --dump-config-schema           print JSON Schema for profile entries and
                                 patches without mounting
  --dump-default-config          print the profile tree without its user layer
                                 or --patch overlays and exit

Examples:
  liwa web                                   boot the web profile (same as: liwa --profile web)
  liwa rescue --from-default-profile web
                                            recreate rescue from the shipped web template, then boot it
  liwa headless "run the tests"              answer one task, print the result, and exit
  liwa tui --patch ./extra.yml               boot a custom profile with one extra overlay
  liwa tui --resume <session>                arguments after the launcher flags reach the app
  liwa web --help                            the web app's own flags and help
  liwa plugin --profile tui add <package>    install a plugin into the tui profile

```

<a id="liwa-plugin"></a>
## `liwa plugin`

调用方式: `liwa plugin --help`

```text
Usage: liwa plugin [options] [args...]

manage a profile's plugins by forwarding the remaining arguments to pnpm in the
profile directory

Arguments:
  args              pnpm arguments, forwarded verbatim (add <pkg>, remove <pkg>,
                    why <pkg>, ...)

Options:
  --profile <name>  the profile whose plugins to manage (initialized on first
                    use)
  -h, --help        show this help
```

<a id="liwa-brain"></a>
## `liwa brain`

调用方式: `liwa brain --help`, `liwa brain help --help`, `liwa --profile brain --help`, `liwa --profile brain help --help`

```text
Usage: liwa brain [options] [command]

Inspect and try the agent CLI providers mounted in this profile.

Options:
  -h, --help                 show this help

Commands:
  list [options]             list the registered providers and probe each of
                             them
  probe [options] <impl>     probe one provider: availability, version, and
                             problems
  run [options] <prompt...>  open one session in this process, stream its
                             events, run one turn, and close it
  help [command]             display help for command

Examples:
  liwa brain list                                   list providers and probe them
  liwa brain probe claude                           check one provider in detail
  liwa brain run --provider deepseek "hello"        open a session, run one turn, close it
  liwa brain run --provider deepseek --mode plan --permit deny --cwd ./repo "plan the fix"
  liwa brain run --provider deepseek --image ./shot.png "what is in this picture?"

```

<a id="liwa-brain-run"></a>
## `liwa brain run`

调用方式: `liwa brain run --help`, `liwa --profile brain run --help`

```text
Usage: liwa brain run [options] <prompt...>

open one session in this process, stream its events, run one turn, and close it

Arguments:
  prompt               the prompt; multiple words are joined by spaces

Options:
  --provider <impl>    provider implementation name
  --model <model>      model id handed to the provider (default: the provider
                       CLI's own default model)
  --cwd <dir>          working directory of the session (default: the current
                       directory)
  --mode <mode>        provider-specific session mode, e.g. plan or default
                       (default: the provider's default mode)
  --thinking <option>  thinking option of the chosen model, e.g. high or off
                       (default: the model's default)
  --permit <policy>    how permission requests and questions are answered
                       (default: ask on a terminal, deny otherwise) (choices:
                       "ask", "allow-once", "allow-session", "deny")
  --image <file>       attach an image (png, jpeg, webp, gif) to the prompt;
                       repeatable (default: [])
  --member <name>      member that owns the session (default: cli)
  --mind <kind>        session kind (default: work) (choices: "instance",
                       "work", "think", "own", "tidy")
  --json               print each event as one JSON line
  -h, --help           show this help
```

<a id="liwa-headless"></a>
## `liwa headless`

调用方式: `liwa headless --help`, `liwa --profile headless --help`

```text
Usage: liwa --profile headless [options] [task...]

Answer one task and exit; the answer goes to stdout and diagnostics to stderr.

Arguments:
  task                        the task text; multiple words are joined by
                              spaces, and `-` reads stdin

Options:
  --json                      write newline-delimited run events to stdout
                              instead of the final message
  --session-id <id>           adopt the persisted Session with this id; an
                              unknown id is an error
  --permission-mode <preset>  select a configured permission preset for this
                              task, including on resume
  --approval-policy <policy>  set approval behavior after selecting the
                              permission preset (choices: "ask", "never")
  --add-dir <path>            allow an additional physical absolute directory
                              under workspace-write (repeatable)
  -h, --help                  show this help

Examples:
  liwa --profile headless "run the tests"          answer one task and exit
  echo "run the tests" | liwa --profile headless   read the task from stdin
  liwa --profile headless --json "run the tests"   emit machine-readable run events
  liwa --profile headless --session-id session-… "continue"   resume an existing Session
  liwa --profile headless --permission-mode workspace-write --add-dir /repo/.git "commit the fix"
                                                        grant shared Git metadata for this task

```

<a id="liwa-web"></a>
## `liwa web`

调用方式: `liwa web --help`, `liwa --profile web --help`

```text
Usage: liwa --profile web [options]

Serve the Liwa browser UI.

Options:
  --host <host>                  bind address: one concrete IPv4 or IPv6 literal
                                 of a local interface; wildcard addresses are
                                 rejected
  --no-open                      do not open the Web UI in the default browser
  --port <port>                  listen port; pass 0 to let the OS pick a free
                                 one
  --public-url <url>             advertise this HTTP(S) root in the printed,
                                 opened, runtime-context, and LIWA_WEB_URL
                                 forms; grants no trust
  --trusted-host <authority...>  extra authority the /api browser-trust fence
                                 accepts (host or host:port; repeatable)
  --tls-cert <file>              PEM server certificate chain; requires
                                 --tls-key
  --tls-key <file>               unencrypted PEM private key; requires
                                 --tls-cert
  -h, --help                     show this help

Examples:
  liwa --profile web                          serve on the composed host and port
  liwa --profile web --no-open                serve without opening a browser
  liwa --profile web --port 8080              serve on another port
  liwa --profile web --host 10.0.0.7          bind one local interface address
  liwa --profile web --public-url https://app.example/ui/ --trusted-host app.example
                                             advertise a prefix-stripping HTTPS proxy entry and admit its authority
  liwa --profile web --tls-cert ./server-chain.pem --tls-key ./server-key.pem
                                             serve HTTPS with an existing certificate and key

```
